title: kajisho5/ffmpeg-skill
lede: ffmpeg-skill gives Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and other MCP clients a local video editor: FFmpeg tools the agent drives through a fixed probe, edit, check and verify workflow.

points: Each tool is a Python script with typed flags; nothing runs through a shell and callers cannot pass raw filter graphs.
A machine-readable contract lists each tool's inputs, outputs, required FFmpeg components and how to verify its result.
The MCP server builds its tool list from each script's argparse parser, and CI fails if the schema drifts.
Every tool supports --dry-run and --json; output is probed, checked against platform specs and inspected as a contact sheet.
Templates render TikTok, Reels, Shorts, YouTube and other deliverables in one command; speech transcription is optional and stays on the machine.

points.text: Picture tools given an audio-only output extension fail inside ffmpeg instead of being refused up front.
A cluster of bugs where streams are dropped or put in the wrong container, found while fixing earlier reports.
Multi-clip crop projects keep letterbox bars on clips of another aspect, because join pads before fit crops.
The maintainer wants Windows, Cursor and Codex installs checked on other people's machines.
